d.ko: Classic 2D platformer, play as a nimble elf and dash through the ancient fairytale forest. Defeat powerful Insomniac creatures, cast spells by combining four elements to summon thunder and entangle flame. Collect the heart of the goddess, unleash the hidden power of your Silver Axe.
d.en: Classic 2D platformer, play as a nimble elf and dash through the ancient fairytale forest. Defeat powerful Insomniac creatures, cast spells by combining four elements to summon thunder and entangle flame. Collect the heart of the goddess, unleash the hidden power of your Silver Axe.
d.zh:
改编童话《诚实的樵夫》的2D动作平台游戏，扮演身手灵活的精灵，进入魔法森林击败森林头目，解开女神沉睡的谜团。
运用「根源召唤」施展精灵的招式，组合4种根源，施放20种不同风格的招式技能，缠绕火焰、呼唤雷击，操使银斧与魔法迎接一场又一场紧张刺激、丰富有趣的头目挑战。
